sar.narrative: This report by the issuing bank concerns an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern suspected on card C11663-K1 held by customer C11663; internal case AC-HHF-003 (alert HHF-003) was opened 2017-01-31. The subjects are customer C11663 and card C11663-K1, a debit mastercard card; a profile shared with 5 other cards carrying confirmed fraud within 30 days. The same device profile was used on 5 other cards (C04096-K1, C07847-K1, C08563-K1, C09026-K1, C09148-K1), which are treated as connected. The activity consists of 7 transactions between 2017-01-22 and 2017-01-31 totaling $8,551.47. On 2017-01-22 at 12:55 a $181.73 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0; on 2017-01-23 at 07:25 a $357.82 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0; on 2017-01-24 at 19:13 a $811.92 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0. On 2017-01-26 at 19:51 a $1,800.00 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0; on 2017-01-27 at 19:12 a $1,800.00 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0; on 2017-01-28 at 17:31 a $1,800.00 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 327.0. On 2017-01-31 at 17:31 a $1,800.00 online purchase (product code C) billed in region 315.0. The activity is inconsistent with the cardholder's history: the card's 57 prior transactions had a median amount of $91.98 and a maximum of $1,800.00; coordinated dormant-wake escalating online drain across 6 cards with no identity records: card C11663-K1 woke after at least 21 days without activity into 7 online ProductCD='C' charges (3660147, 3660148, 3660149, 3660150, 3660151, 3660152, 3660153) ramping $181.73 -> $357.82 -> $811.92 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 -> $1,800.00 (total $8,551.47), matching 5 peer cards exhibiting the same doubling ramp. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on this card; OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. Actions: an internal fraud case, monitoring of the connected cards, block and reissue of the card (fraud-manager approval requested), this filing (fraud-manager approval requested), escalation to a fraud analyst; total suspicious amount $8,551.47. Supporting documentation, including the transaction records and device evidence, is retained on file for five years and is available to law enforcement on request.
